quest.title: Seirai Stormchasers: Part I
quest.description: You learn from Inazuma's Katheryne that the Inazuma Adventurers' Guild has been gathering adventurers to explore Seirai Island recently...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x4, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmm. Well done, well done indeed. I acknowledge your efforts.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: This should be the first step on the shrine's return to its former bustling state — you are also free to offer Mora yourself, should it please you.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: As we agreed, then. I shall instruct you in the sealing of those rocks.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: This island plays host to four such stones. Hibiki once said that they were meant to seal a bird of most prodigious size.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A bird of... prodigious size?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki said that that bird's strength was a truly frightening thing, capable of singeing the fur off all the cats on this island.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: This shrine, too, was built to subdue it, so I heard from her.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hmm... Meow... The exact details escape me, and it is a mighty shame that Hibiki is not here, or you could ask her directly.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Yet I still recall the sealing methods for the... meow, four stones. You must... Hmm... Meow, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Hibiki said that the key is to use the ropes on the rock, and the piece of paper...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ropes? Paper?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The paper on the sticks by the rock's side must become the same as the paper on the rock itself...

choices.text: Clear as mud.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: You seem confused. Perhaps your comprehension is lacking also... Paper with paper, and rock. Did you get that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is this, some weird game of rock-paper-scissors?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Rock-paper-scissors? I fail to understand...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Mmm... If your comprehension fails you here... Have you any of those wooden planks left? I will carve an image of what needs to be done.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: S—Sure...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Now, surely, you understand. This is how one seals the rocks, and where they are.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Go now, and quickly. The shrine's maintenance yet requires my attention.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hah, now that the Offering Box has been repaired, the shrine shall soon return to its former thriving glory...

choices.text: Again, you're really good with those claws...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Small beans it was, really.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Visit the shrine after some days. Once it grows busy around these parts once more, I am certain that more humans will come to pay their respects.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I may yet require your aid again then.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hibiki would be most gratified to see this shrine become lively again. Hmm, well, and that Domeki fellow, too... Meow...

choices.text: Such a detailed carving...
I—I see...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello there, Adventurer. Have your recent adventures been going smoothly?

choices.text: You could say so.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I would expect no less of you. Keep that up, and I'm sure you'll be a most excellent adventurer.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Speaking of which, the Guild is currently looking for adventurers to explore Seirai Island. Would you be interested?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seirai Island?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Yes. It is an island to the south of Narukami Island, with some parts of the island being subject to constant wild storms that have impeded the Guild's exploration work thus far.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: While we have sent two adventurers, Miss Etsuko and Mr. Taisuke, to remain on Seirai Island and investigate a way to calm the storm...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: I'm afraid that they haven't come up with any leads thus far...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: If you're interested, go to Seirai Island and have a look. It has also been said that the island is full of buried treasure.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: That said, please be careful while you explore Seirai Island.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: After all, we have yet to determine the cause of those storms.

choices.text: There's no commission I can't complete!

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I'll need this book... and this one... and this one...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Ah! Hello there. You're... an adventurer? Hmm. Am I right to say that you're here to investigate this island?

choices.text: That is the case.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I see... In that case, you can explore the periphery of this island a bit.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: But don't wander too close to the center of this island as you please. The storms there are not to be trifled with.

choices.text: Is there no way to solve this issue?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Not for now... Actually, I haven't even figured out the cause of these storms yet.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: That fellow Taisuke keeps insisting that the storm must have been the work of the Archon, meant to block ordinary people from violating a sacred site.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I didn't believe a word of it at first, but then we discovered some very strange stone structures in the area.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Taisuke read in a text he found that these structures are known as "Warding Stones."

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: And according to the legends, these stone structures really are ritual implements that can be used to seal certain things.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Unfortunately, the stone structures we found were all busted up, and not one looks like it's been repaired in who knows how many years...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: *sigh* We lack the clues we need to solve this mystery. How very frustrating... But since it's work, I suppose we've just got to give it a go.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where did you find them?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Not far. Taisuke's been there the whole time investigating. I just came back to help him grab some books. If you want to go have a look, I can just take you there.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: The quicker we solve the mystery behind that Warding Stone, the sooner we can report back to the Guild.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Just... hold on a moment while I bundle this stuff up...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Alright, that's that. Let's go!

choices.text: Are there only storms over there?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Yes. Strange, isn't it? It's almost like... something's drawn a boundary for the storms.

choices.text: You could say that.

talks.objective: Look for the adventurers on Seirai Island
Go to investigate the Warding Stone

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: This seal... No, no...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Taisuke, I brought the resources that you asked for.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: That's odd. This architecture doesn't fit...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Hey, Taisuke!

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Ah!? E—Etsuko, come on, you don't have to be so loud. You almost gave me a heart attack! I mean, you didn't, of course, but haven't you ever considered that the racket you were making might attract monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah! Look, I called for you several times already, and you didn't respond at all!

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Well then. Guess who's got all the resources you asked for? And guess who's brought a little help from the Guild to boot?

choices.text: Why hello there.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Oh... Oh! Pleased to meet you, yes, nice to meet you indeed! My name is Taisuke, and I'm an adventurer with Inazuma's Adventurers' Guild...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Yes, yes, very nice. We're all adventurers here, no need for the whole song-and-dance.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Oh, don't say that! We should at least exercise some basic courtesy.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: We busy ourselves out in the wild so often. It's only right that we maintain a good attitude and outlook during our down-time.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: You... Ugh, never mind...

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: I've told you that many times, haven't I? A good attitude starts with treating people with politeness...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Okay, enough already. How are your Warding Stone studies going?

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Basically, we've made zero progress. All we've found is some strange tracks.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, that was quick.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: No progress, huh... We've been here for quite a while now. If we don't make some headway soon, we should probably ask the Guild for additional help.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: A—Additional help? Wouldn't that be the same as admitting that we're not up to the task?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Taisuke, I believe I've said this before. We're professionals. Taking commissions is work.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Our goal is to finish our work, not prove ourselves.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: If we screw up while trying to prove ourselves, we'd lose more than we'd gain.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's professional ethics for you...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Thanks, but I wouldn't claim to speak for anyone else.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Some Guild members say that I've got no spirit... Others say that I just work for the sake of working.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: But whether they like it or not, I've got the highest commission completion efficiency in the Guild.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, what's your reason for being an adventurer, then?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Work. Mora. That's it, really.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Simple goals, I see...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Well, maybe it's because my goals are so simple that the Guild tends to send me out to complete commissions more often than most.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Heh, but it seems like I won't be able to clear this one solo.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Miss Etsuko... Please keep your spirits up. The Guild did give us this commission, after all.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I'm already giving it my 100%... It's just too much to ask for me to give my 120%.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Well, whatever. Tell us about those strange tracks.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: They're a cat's tracks. They go from this Warding Stone's side and stretch all the way out.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: I remember you mentioning that they belonged to a cat... That doesn't sound like it would have anything to do with this Warding Stone.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Well, but we could still follow these tracks to have a look...

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Yes, yes, they are quite strange. But I'd say that we should focus on the Warding Stone.

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: Once we've worked out how it functions, we can go follow those tracks.

response.speaker: Taisuke
response.text: Miss Etsuko... Are you just unwilling to walk any further, by any chance?

response.speaker: Etsuko
response.text: No, I'm being rigorous. Let's start already.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like they're determined to look into that Warding Stone first...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, Paimon's quite concerned about those cat tracks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since they appeared just beside the Warding Stone, maybe they really do have something to do with it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's follow them and see what we can find!

choices.text: An honor to make your acquaintance.

talks.objective: Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: The books do say that Warding Stones are implements for sealing rituals.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: However, the form and shape of this one doesn't quite match up with what we find in the text...

talks.objective: Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Well, that's this Warding Stone squared away, right?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: And yet the storm hasn't abated at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we've got to seal all four of them.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: That seems to be case.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Well, that Neko's already marked all four Warding Stone locations on the wooden plank, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Indeed. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Yup, let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Could I at least go visit the shrine and see Neko...?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: You can do that once the storm's gone. Come on!

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Oh... Okay then...

talks.objective: Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead
Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: *sigh* It really stinks, not being able to find any leads...
Haah... At last, human guests.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—That cat... It's t—talking!
Ho. Does the sight of me frighten you so?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Paimon's just never seen a talking animal before...
Most rude of you. Are you not a talking animal also?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon isn't an animal!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, calm down...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, hmm, we have met quite a few talking animals, haven't we?

choices.text: We met a talking dragon, yes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Dragons count as "animals"? Paimon feels like they belong in a higher class than that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But well, Dvalin does talk...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, whatever the case, this is the first time Paimon's met a talking cat...
Such wanton yammering! I am no "talking cat."
This is the Asase Shrine, and I am Neko, the provisional head priestess.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Other felines address me as "Her Ladyship, the Provisional Head Priestess." But since our fates are twined, you may dispense with such formality.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do other cats talk too?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Surely. You just comprehend them not.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: But you are no fools, certainly, considering that you knew to follow mine instruction.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Most boring things would be if you were as dull as those other two humans, picking and scratching at rocks as they do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Rocks, huh... Oh, you mean the Warding Stone from before?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I know not what they are named. It is a pile of rocks with a rope tied across it, no?

choices.text: So you were the one who asked those cats to...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I did indeed call upon some felines to frolic there. Consider it a test of your intellect.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hibiki unsealed these rocks a good, long time ago. It has much to do with those...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: ...Those purple, tingling, hair-raising, ill-meaning things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Purple, tingly things... Do you mean Electro?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Electro really is running amok here on Seirai Island, that's for sure...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I can instruct you in the manner of operating those rocks. But in exchange...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Want our help, do you?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Ah, there it is again, your superb comprehension. Mine eyes did not judge you poorly, human.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Provisional head priestess of the Asase Shrine I may be, but there are some tasks that mine paws lack skill in.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: For instance, the shrine suffers from a dearth of incense. Were Hibiki to see it in such a sorry state, she would surely be grieved.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Much thought did I give it before realizing that if the shrine's Offering Box were to be fixed, people would come to deposit Mora there, thus reviving the shrine.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's not quite that simple...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Mora is stuffed into the Offering Box. When it was yet whole, many people would come to stuff Mora into it, thus making the shrine most busy indeed.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Once the box was damaged, no one came to put Mora in, and thus did the shrine fall silent...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: It thus stands to reason, then, that should this box be repaired, people will return to offer Mora, and the shrine shall be revivified. Is that not so?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's hard to fault that reasoning... But at the same time, something doesn't fit...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Whatever the case may be, I remember that people always came to maintain the Offering Box, which was why the shrine thrived and the incense within burned well.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: The human in charge of those repairs lived in the village over there, but he hasn't come in a good long time...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Indeed, after that huge, huge storm, Hibiki, Domeki, and the others never returned, either.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Whatever the case may be, I now fully understand that so long as the Offering Box is repaired, the shrine can be restored to its former glory.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: As such, you shall help me to repair the box, and I will teach you the way to seal those stones.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you really know how to work with those Warding Stones?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hah, naturally. Many a time have I seen Hibiki seal them... and unseal them, too.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: There should be no problem at all.

choices.text: Should?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Meow, meow, meow?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously!? You're playing dumb about something like this!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if we wanna fix the box, we're going to need a lot of materials.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, like wooden planks, nails, ropes... Do we have that sort of stuff here at the shrine?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I have maintained this shrine exceedingly well. No such detritus exists here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But those are exactly the things we're gonna need!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well then, where can we find these materials?

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I am a cat. Where would I obtain knowledge of such things?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where did the person in charge of maintenance live?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! The person in charge of maintenance must've kept some spare supplies. We can go have a look...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Mmm, that is a fair point you make. Bring forth your map — I shall mark the location out for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, she really marked it out...

choices.text: Huh, so that's how you make marks — with your claws...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: But of course.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: There. I have given you the general location you require.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: I shall leave the box repairs to... you... Meow...

choices.text: Those are some flexible claws you've got.
Well, I'd pass for a dab hand at repairs.
So those cat footprints were your doing...
Didn't we meet a talking snake?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! You mean that snake named Changsheng?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Was that really not a "herb"?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: I really have maintained this shrine well...

talks.objective: Go to the village and look for materials with which to initiate repairs

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: A talking cat, huh... I sure would love to go see it myself...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: O—Oh, hello there. Miss Etsuko's always done things like that, so don't think too much of it.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: She doesn't look very serious... but she's actually a very skilled adventurer. There isn't a commission that she hasn't seen through to perfection.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: She claims that this is because she's never taken up any commission that she didn't think she could clear...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: But in my view, having such sound judgment is quite the skill in and of itself.

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Agh! No more, please! We yield, we yield!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you doing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: We... We were just trying our luck, doing a little digging, you know?

choices.text: Tell me the truth.

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Wait! Please! We'll talk, we'll talk!

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: We heard from some people that there was treasure to be had here on Seirai Island, and that the island itself wasn't all that populated...

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: So we decided to come over and see what we could find.

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: But... But we really haven't found anything! This village doesn't look like it's been tended for archon-knows how many years, either...

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Forget treasure, we were hard-pressed to find a plank of wood that wasn't broken around here!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? All the wood's ruined? Th—Then how are we supposed to find repair materials?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you have a camp?

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: W—Well, yes we do. But what do you plan to—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Does that camp have nails, wooden planks, and rope in it?

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Err, yes, it does...

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Pl—Please, just tell us what you want! There's no need to speak in code!

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: You've beaten us, so whether you want Mora or treasure, it's all yours!

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: J—Just please, spare our lives...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, those things are exactly what I want.

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Huh? Then... Well, then please, just go to our camp and take whatever you need.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what are you going to do?

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: We... We've got other things to attend to, so let's part ways here!

response.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Come on lads, let's go! Move it!

choices.text: Three... two...

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this thing's in a real state! Looks like nobody's come to fix it up in ages.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Forget maintaining it, we might as well make a new one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's head for that village quick. Maybe we'll find something we can use.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, here's our village. Let's take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Treasure Hoarders, here? What are they doing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is bad! We can't have them grabbing those materials ahead of us. Time to stop 'em!

talks.objective: Search for repair materials in the camp
Search for repair materials in the camp
Search for repair materials in the camp
Return to the Asase Shrine and fix the Offering Box

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, Paimon thinks that those Treasure Hoarders might have misunderstood us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it doesn't matter. Let's just go grab what we need from their camp.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we've got what we came for. Time to fix that Offering Box.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're taking all the stuff, by the way. Paimon couldn't carry them to save her life!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon is just little ol' Paimon, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Hmm, so this Warding Stone is actually divided into an upper and lower section, and it can be rotated...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: If we rotate it correctly, something might happen...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Uh huh. And what is this "correct rotation"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've figured it out.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Oh? You're back. We were just starting to wonder where you'd gone.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Wait? Seal? Th—This Warding Stone needs to be sealed, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Huh. A talking cat, you say... Guarding an abandoned shrine?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: And that cat told you how to seal the Warding Stones?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: That's... just incredible... Maybe the Guild's rated this commission's difficulty a little too low.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Miss Etsuko, this isn't the time to worry about Guild evaluations...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Look! The words on this wooden plank seem to have been made using claws!

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: This... is just incredible. Is that cat named Neko still at that shrine?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Will I need to bring any greeting gifts when I go there to pay respects?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: You know, like fish, cat food, things like that...?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Taisuke, please. We need to seal the Warding Stone first. Guild commission, remember?

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Right... Right! I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Alright then, let's figure out how we're supposed to do this sealing business.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: But according to this wooden plank, it isn't going to be that easy.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: The repairs... please... Meow, meow...

choices.text: Why'd you stop speaking...

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Speaking your language is... tiring... Meow...

choices.text: I'll get the box fixed, don't worry.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: This matter is in your hands, meow meow...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Sealing this Warding Stone isn't going to be that simple...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: And I'm also quite concerned about one other thing.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Since what we're doing is "sealing" this Warding Stone to calm the storm...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: That means that someone must've unsealed the stones in general at some point in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Whoever that is, they're responsible for this storm on Seirai Island.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: But who would... and why would anyone do something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: This is really troublesome. Definitely doesn't sound like something I want to get mixed up in...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Perhaps it might be better to report back to the Guild and request that they send some extra people to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, this thing's in a real state! Looks like nobody's come to fix it up in ages.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Forget maintaining it, we might as well make a new one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's head for that village quick. Maybe we'll find something we can use.
